The dashboard form's Default Period select now names its choices (Today, This month, Last 30 days, Custom… and so on) instead of the stored values, from one shared table (`defaultPeriodOptions()`) that the report form reads too. The Date Range group lists its three rows by name, and a Chinese Studio session reads the period names from the console's locale packs, through the helper the report inspector uses. `Clause-②: no`. Nothing is left on this card; `pm:dispatched` removed.
